N6.summary: delta note: the in-lock untyped-failure clause is deterministically testable at the _verified_manifest seam; the author's 'no deterministic test -- racing verify->dlopen required' was overstated.
N6.disposition: ADOPTED. test_installed_loader.py::test_in_lock_untyped_validator_failure_declines_not_crashes monkeypatches the seam to raise KeyError (mid-load manifest swap consequence) and asserts auto -> quiet None with declined-corrupt reason naming the class + builder_spy empty + IoSpy pure, explicit -> CorruptNativeArtifact 'packaging defect' + class name. Cites the reviewer's delta section 9 in its docstring. WRITING THE TEST EXPOSED A REAL GAP: in-lock declines (the N1 clause and the pre-existing NativeHandleError branch) were cached in _REGISTRY but never reached the private decline log, so decline_reasons() showed nothing for them; installed_loader.py now calls _record for a non-LOADED in-lock outcome after publication (_record's cache guard sees the _REGISTRY entry and appends only the diagnostic line -- no double caching). Teeth: with only the in-lock untyped-failure clause stripped the test fails via raw KeyError propagation; with only the _record line stripped it fails on the empty decline log; both restored -> 48/48 green.
